subject: Request: 'PinLife' emergency rollback drill & maintenance window for Private deployment
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Wu <elaine@acmehealth.com>, Acme Health - Ops <ops@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: 'PinLife' emergency rollback drill & maintenance window for Private deployment

Elaine / Acme ops team —

Thanks again for the quick sync on Thursday. As discussed, we want to run a short, scoped rehearsal of our emergency rollback flow against your Private deployment (VPC), primarily to validate:

- version pin lifecycle transitions (pin -> unpin -> re-pin),
- network quiesce and KV cache rehydration timing,
- automated fast-revert token behavior and traffic cutover, and
- telemetry + audit log completeness for SOC evidence.

Proposed plan (high level):
1) Dry-run in staging (no traffic): 2026-10-05 09:00–11:00 PT
2) Short canary on prod-node slice (redirect ~2% traffic): 2026-10-12 02:00–03:30 PT
3) Emergency rollback drill (simulated pin eviction + automated revert): 2026-10-12 03:45–04:15 PT

We think the target maintenance window for the full minor patch is 2026-10-19 01:00–05:00 PT; the drill will validate our backout criteria before that window. I've attached a compact patch matrix and a draft rollback playbook (links below).

Immediate asks:
- Please confirm the 10/05 and 10/12 windows work for Acme ops.
- Identify the on-call network engineer we should loop in for the canary/rollback drill.
- Any compliance evidence you need captured beyond audit logs (e.g., packet captures, signed change approvals).

Attachments: pinlife_patch_matrix_v3.xlsx (matrix of affected services / pin groups), pinlife_rollback_playbook_v1.md (rehearsal steps + abort criteria).

If that schedule looks reasonable I'll send calendar invites and a short runbook tailored to your cluster names.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Product Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Elaine Wu <elaine@acmehealth.com>, Acme Health - Ops <ops@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 'PinLife' emergency rollback drill & maintenance window for Private deployment

Jordan / Elaine —

I ran a quick pass on the attached matrix and marked three risky surfaces that need explicit gating during the drill:

1) KV cache eviction order: when we unpin a model version on a node, the KV cache drains asynchronously; if we trigger traffic reroute too early we get elevated p99s.
   - Rehearsal step: validate KV drain time on a 100k active Conversation workload in staging.

2) Long-running user sessions: clients using streaming RPCs can hold old KV pointers.
   - Abortion criterion: if >0.5% of active streams are still pinned to the old version after 3 minutes, abort and re-pin.

3) Network ACL re-apply latency: some on-prem net devices we saw take ~90s to re-apply ACLs during prior drills.

Operational notes:
- For the canary slice we'll use pin-group: acme-prod-slice-B (see matrix).
- We'll exercise both the automatic 'fast-revert token' and the manual revert path so the CS/ops playbook covers both.
- Telemetry: ensure the ingested audit_events include 'pin_state_change' and 'rollback_initiator' fields. I added a column in the spreadsheet.

Attachments: updated pinlife_patch_matrix_v3.xlsx (column: gate_timers, test_payload).

I'm available to join the rehearsals as the ops tech lead. Soojin — can you confirm the exact telemetry hooks we'll collect and whether the audit log includes the originating API key and IP?

-karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Lead Infrastructure Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Elaine Wu <elaine@acmehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Health - Ops <ops@acmehealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Sep 2026 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 'PinLife' emergency rollback drill & maintenance window for Private deployment

Jordan / team —

Thanks — that plan looks sensible. A few constraints from our side:

- The 10/05 staging window works. 10/12 is tight for us in-app (we've got a compliance scan that night); can we shift the canary/drill to 2026-10-13 02:00–04:00 PT instead?
- Our network on-call for that week is Samir Patel (samir.patel@acmehealth.com). Loop him in for the canary and the rollback drill.
- For compliance evidence we'll need packet capture of the canary cutover (p-capture-ops-001) and a signed change approval saved to your DocuSign link.

One question: if the fast-revert token triggers a revert, what happens to in-flight streaming responses? Will clients see truncated streams or an explicit error? We need exact wording for our user-facing SLA communication.

I'll confirm after I loop Samir — otherwise good to proceed with invites.

—Elaine
Elaine Wu
Director, Platform Engineering
Acme Health
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Wu <elaine@acmehealth.com>, Acme Health - Ops <ops@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 24 Sep 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 'PinLife' emergency rollback drill & maintenance window for Private deployment

Thanks, Elaine — good catches. Quick answers and next steps:

- We can move the canary/drill to 2026-10-13 02:00–04:00 PT. I'll update the invites.
- Loop Samir once you confirm; we'll add him to the NetOps checklist and bridge invite.
- Packet captures: yes, we'll enable the pcap on the canary node and hand you the pcap artifact (p-capture-ops-001).
- Fast-revert behavior for streaming RPCs: the runtime will try a graceful KV handoff for up to 45s. During that time in-flight tokens may complete; after 45s we force-close sessions returning a 503 with a short machine-readable payload {"error":"service_unavailable","reason":"rollback_in_progress"}. We'll include the exact error string in the customer-facing blurb.

Action items I own:
- Send updated invites and runbook by EOD Monday (2026-09-27).
- Publish the targeted SLA blurb and change notice for your review (Naomi will draft).
- Finalize telemetry list (Soojin + Karthik) and put the audit event schema into the Confluence runbook.

If everyone agrees, we'll treat the canary as the gating milestone before the full 10/19 maintenance window.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Product Manager, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
